title: Implement IPFS pin API wrapper
description:
Implement PinClient: pin(cid), unpin(cid), is_pinned(cid) -> bool over the selected IPFS client library. Artifact: transit/src/retention/pin_client.rs. Must handle the case where the IPFS node is temporarily unreachable (retry with backoff, surface error after max retries).

Acceptance:
- pin() and unpin() work against a local IPFS node in an integration test
- is_pinned() returns correct value after pin/unpin
- Retry logic: 3 attempts with exponential backoff before returning error
- pin() is idempotent (pinning already-pinned CID is not an error)
